name: Sunday I Will Treat You Good

podcast.body: This song was Sparklehorse's one and only alt-rock hit, featured on their 1996 debut album *Vivadixie Submarine Transmission Plot*. Its success earned the band a spot on a European tour with Radiohead, but this tour was marred by a severe personal crisis for frontman Mark Linkous. "It featured the band's one and only alt-rock hits."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
